name: MEV bot 0xa47b unguarded callback
summary: The MEV bot's Balancer receiveFlashLoan callback did not check that the bot had started the loan and executed the swap route encoded in userData. The attacker flash-loaned 1 wei to the bot with a route that sent the bot's WETH through its own swap module into a Uniswap V3 swap paying the attacker, then through a fake pair.
notes: The bot is a metamorphic CREATE2 proxy with its implementation baked into the runtime; the operator re-created it in 0x51819d7c. Self-destruct had cleared its module registry, and ten blocks later the operator re-registered the swap modules the exploit routed through (0x2d0037e6 moved the WETH), so that registration is the reset.
Earlier receiveFlashLoan calls since the re-creation were the bot's own flash loans (bot-initiated, entry selector 0x627dd56a); the anchor is the only external one.
